subject: macro stage advancing over an unclosed department cycle
scenario: The two levels are joined by three predicates in a stage's definition of done. Drop them, or claim the cycle at the wrong stage, and the macro workflow walks forward while a department still has work in rework, an open escalation and no rollup. The board says the stage is done; the department says otherwise, and nobody is reading both.
expected_behaviors: Every stage that declares a department_cycle also declares a cycle_role, and only the completing stage carries cycle_accepted, cycle_rollup_reported and no_open_rework.
Each cycle is completed at exactly one stage per workflow, and no stage is claimed by two cycles.
Entering and continuing stages must not carry the completion predicates, so the cycle cannot be closed early.
Rework is bounded in every cycle and has a declared action at the limit.
Both peer and lead review can request changes, so a cycle can actually stay open.
Every stage declares its full contract, so a stage cannot advance on an unstated definition of done.
failure_conditions: A completing stage drops cycle_accepted, cycle_rollup_reported or no_open_rework.
An entering stage carries a completion predicate and closes the cycle before the work is done.
A cycle is completed at two stages, or at none.
A rework loop becomes unbounded, so a work item can never reach the escalation that would surface it.

checks.description: The join between the macro workflow and the department cycle, checked in both directions.
A stage whose cycle can only close with an experimental agent team would block whenever teams are off.
A cycle that is entered somewhere and completed somewhere else is the case the join exists for.

checks.pattern: A macro stage cannot advance until its department cycle reaches ACCEPTED
Its definition of done carries cycle_accepted

checks.description: Hitting the rework limit has somewhere to go other than round again.

notes: scripts/inject_faults.py F-07 and F-08 exercise the runtime half of this: a cycle over its rework limit and a cycle at it. This case asserts the structural half, that the predicates are wired to the right stages in the first place.
